capabilities.justification: Calls the reviewed Rust Conduit C ABI through GHC foreign import ccall bindings.
Loads the conduit_capi dynamic library through the operating-system loader at process startup.
The public bind API opens caller-selected TCP listeners through conduit_capi.
End-to-end tests connect to the loopback listener with raw HTTP sockets.
End-to-end tests resolve the numeric loopback host before connecting to the listener.
End-to-end tests use bounded thread delays while starting and stopping the server.
Error callbacks write caught handler exceptions to the standard error output stream.

justification: Haskell FFI wrapper over conduit_capi that can bind TCP listeners; its end-to-end tests connect on loopback and wait for server transitions, and error handling writes caught exceptions to standard error.
